summary: Oruka Therapeutics filed an 8-K (Items 7.01 and 8.01) to announce Phase 2a EVERLAST-A clinical trial results for ORKA-001, an anti-IL-23 antibody for moderate-to-severe psoriasis. The filing discloses that 84 patients were randomized 3:1 to receive 600 mg ORKA-001 or placebo, meeting the primary endpoint of PASI 100 at Week 16. No financial terms, stake, premium, or deal structure are included; this is an operational update. The data is for informational and regulatory disclosure purposes only. Watch for further trial data and regulatory interactions; no risk-arb angle exists as this is not a special-situation event.
